dec.ct: Supreme Court of Papua New Guinea
dec.pe: Australia sent asylum seekers to a centre on Manus Island in Papua New Guinea. The Supreme Court of Papua New Guinea said holding them there was unconstitutional.
dec.pi: Australia mengirim pencari suaka ke sebuah pusat di Pulau Manus, Papua Nugini. MA Papua Nugini menyatakan penahanan mereka di sana inkonstitusional.
